work.author: Clemens etc.
work.description: Entire separate Paderborn letter, printed as §§8–9 after Speyer decree but addressed to a different elect and dated1773, read with context. Literal chancery abbreviations are complete printed witness, qualified; no title-based Speyer join. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
